# The organization's data

The files ritsu reads the organization and its masters from. A version of the organization is a directory named by the day it takes effect, with `teams.csv`, `people.csv` and `members.csv`, or one `organization.json` of the same columns (`schema.json`). `proxies.csv` is beside the versions' directories. A cell left empty is none.

## The organization `company` (Company)

Its file is `examples/shared/company.ringi`, and its data is in `examples/org`.

### `teams.csv`

| Column | Needed | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | The team's ID |
| `name` | yes | Its name |
| `name_ja` | no | Its name in Japanese |
| `kind` | yes | One of `company`, `division`, `department`, `section`, `committee` |
| `parent` | yes | The ID of the team above it; empty for the team at the top |
| `head` | yes | The ID of its head; empty while there is none |

### `people.csv`

| Column | Needed | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | The person's ID |
| `name` | yes | Their name |
| `name_ja` | no | Their name in Japanese |
| `email` | no | Their address |
| `language` | no | The language they read their notices and pages in, `en` or `ja`; empty for the language of each kind |

### `members.csv`

| Column | Needed | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `person` | yes | The person's ID |
| `team` | yes | The team's ID |
| `position` | yes | One of `staff`, `manager`, `dept_head`, `division_head`, `president`, the lowest first |
| `primary` | yes | `yes` for the person's primary team; `no` or empty for a team they also belong to |

### `proxies.csv`

| Column | Needed | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `person` | yes | The ID of the person a proxy stands in for |
| `proxy` | yes | The ID of the proxy |
| `kind` | yes | `approve` or `submit` |
| `from` | yes | The first day, `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `to` | yes | The last day; empty for no end |
| `requests` | no | The kinds of request it is for, their ASCII names apart with spaces; empty for every kind |

## The master `company_masters.accounts` (Account codes)

Its file is `examples/shared/masters.ringi`, and its rows are in `examples/masters/accounts.csv`; its key is `code`.

| Column | Needed | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | Code: text of 10 characters at the most |
| `label` | yes | Name: text of 60 characters at the most |
| `valid_from` | yes | The first day the row may be chosen on; empty for any day before |
| `valid_to` | yes | The last day the row may be chosen on; empty for no end |

## The master `company_masters.vendors` (Vendors)

Its file is `examples/shared/masters.ringi`, and its rows are in `examples/masters/vendors.csv`; its key is `id`.

| Column | Needed | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | Vendor ID: text of 12 characters at the most |
| `name` | yes | Name: text of 100 characters at the most |
| `valid_from` | yes | The first day the row may be chosen on; empty for any day before |
| `valid_to` | yes | The last day the row may be chosen on; empty for no end |

## The master `company_masters.systems` (Systems)

Its file is `examples/shared/masters.ringi`, and its rows are in `examples/masters/systems.csv`; its key is `id`.

|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | System: text of 30 characters at the most |
